title: Services
description: Residential, commercial, senior, and specialty moving services from Mike Hammer Moving — Kansas City, since 1987.

blocks.heading: Everything your move needs
blocks.intro: Full-time, background-checked crews — never temporary day labor — for every size of move.

items.title: Residential moving
items.desc: Local and long-distance household moves — packing, loading, transportation, unloading, and furniture placement.

items.title: Packing & unpacking
items.desc: Pack one room or the whole home. We bring the materials and do as much or as little as you want.

items.title: Commercial & office moving
items.desc: Flexible scheduling, including after-hours and weekends, to keep your business running.

items.title: Senior moving
items.desc: A patient, personalized approach for downsizing and retirement-community moves.

items.title: Specialty moving
items.desc: Pianos, gun safes, and other heavy or awkward items handled with the right equipment.

items.title: Labor-only moving
items.desc: Just need loading or unloading help with your own truck or storage pod? We do that too.

items.title: Packing supplies
items.desc: Boxes and packing materials available on their own, without booking a full move.

items.title: Junk removal
items.desc: Haul-away for the items you're not taking with you.
